name: Stateless transform
title: Stateless Stream Transform
lede: The simplest streaming query: events flow in from the left, an operator handles each one on its own, results flow out to the right. It keeps running until you press Pause.
description: Animated explainer of how Proton streams events through stateless filter and expression operators.

name: Streaming aggregation
title: Streaming Aggregation Lab
lede: Aggregation is where a stream query starts to remember. Watch state build up in a hash table, see watermarks decide when a window is final, and see a checkpoint carry that state across a crash.
description: Animated explainer of Proton global and windowed aggregation, watermarks, emit policies, late events and checkpoints.

name: Streaming join
title: Streaming Join Lab
lede: A join matches events from two inputs. Which side keeps a hash table, and for how long, decides whether the join is cheap or grows without bound.
description: Animated explainer of Proton enrichment and bidirectional joins, range joins and aligned checkpoints.
